candidate.de: Žrnovo’s traditional sword dance, performed on the feast of Sveti Rok (16 August) on the Piazza Pod Kostil in Postrana. candidate.de: Nastupa na ljetnom festivalu u Pupnatu.
candidate.en: Performed in summer, the Kumpanija is a chain sword dance with roots going back centuries, and is listed as an item of UNESCO intangible cultural heritage.
candidate.fr: Exécuté en été, le Kumpanija est une danse de sabres en chaîne avec des racines remontant à des siècles, et est classé comme un bien culturel immatériel de l'UNESCO.
candidate.hr: Održava se u ljetnim mjesecima, Kumpanija je lancući borbeni ples koji potječe stoljećima unatrag, a je i upisana kao UNESCO-ov nepokretni kulturni dobit.
candidate.it: Eseguito in estate, il Kumpanija è una danza di spade in catena con radici che risalgono a secoli fa, e è classificato come bene culturale immateriale dell'UNESCO.
candidate.sl: Se održuje v poletnih mesecih, Kumpanija je verižni borbeni ples, ki se je uporabljal že stoletja in je vpisan kot nepremični kulturni spomenik UNESCO-ja.

candidate.de: Sveti Jakov pilgrimage — the major religious event of the year in Čara, centred on the church of Gospa od Carskog Polja in the field below the village. A traditional procession draws villagers and visitors from across the island.

candidate.de: Kumpanija — Čara is one of the five villages on Korčula Island that preserves the Kumpanija sword dance, a chain sword dance of great antiquity performed in summer and listed as UNESCO intangible cultural heritage.

candidate.de: Walk through Carsko Polje — a walk through the vineyards and olive groves of the field below the village, passing the old church of Gospa od Carskog Polja and the wine cellar, is one of the most pleasant short walks on the island.
candidate.en: Walk through Carsko Polje — a walk through the vineyards and olive groves of the field below the village, passing the old church of Gospa od Carskog Polja and the wine cellar, is one of the most pleasant short walks on the island.

candidate.de: Španić Kastel — the fortified house at the village entrance offers views over the whole valley and out to sea. Worth a look from the outside, even if not open to visitors.
